sources.topic_1: Student Book - Writing (Things you care about when visiting a country)
sources.topic_2: Activity Book - Writing (A festival you have been invited to)

topics.title: Write a paragraph about the things you care about when you visit a country.
guiding_questions: What do you care about most when you visit a country?
Is transportation important for you? Why?
Do you prefer cheap or expensive shopping?
What kind of food do you like when you travel?
If the accommodation is good, will you enjoy your trip?
topics.sample_essay: When I visit a country, I care about many things. First, I care about transportation. If transportation is available, I will visit all places. I also care about shopping. If the shops are cheap, I will buy some gifts. Food is important too. If the cuisine is delicious, I will try new dishes. I think these things make my trip happy.

topics.title: Write a paragraph describing a festival you have been invited to.
guiding_questions: What is the name of the festival?
Did anything special happen that night?
topics.sample_essay: Last year, I was invited to a wedding festival. It was in my city. I saw all my family and friends there. People wore beautiful traditional clothes. The bride and the groom were very happy. We ate delicious food and listened to music. It was a wonderful night. I will never forget this festival.
